blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Anti-narcotics operatives arrested a 47-year-old bookkeeper after seizing nearly P184,000 worth of illegal drugs and live ammunition. The apprehension and the seizure happened during an entrapment operation in Barangay Tiguma, Pagadian City, Tuesday night, October 27. The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency Regional Office 9 – Zamboanga del Sur Provincial Office (PDEA 9 – ZDSPO), which led the joint operation, identified the suspect by her alias “Julay.” Authorities said the suspect is married and resident of Barangay San Francisco.
